fix_code:
n, t = map(int, input().split())
s = [0 for _ in range(n)]
p = {}
p[0] = n
for _ in range(t):  # Corrected loop to iterate over t updates
    a, b = map(int, input().split())
    a -= 1
    p[s[a]] -= 1
    if p[s[a]] == 0:
        del p[s[a]]
    s[a] += b
    if s[a] not in p:
        p[s[a]] = 0
    p[s[a]] += 1
    print(len(p))
